claims.text: metformin, a safe Food and Drug Administration-approved antidiabetic drug, decreased leaky gut and inflammation in high-fat diet-fed older obese mice, by beneficially modulating the gut microbiota.
metformin increased goblet cell mass and mucin production in the obese older gut, thereby decreasing leaky gut and inflammation.
metformin increased the goblet cell differentiation markers by suppressing Wnt signaling.
